name: Puppis
introduction: is the Stern, the largest of the three parts of the ancient ship Argo Navis. It lies in the Milky Way southeast of Sirius, best seen from the Southern Hemisphere and low in northern winter skies.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: [Naos](hip:39429), Zeta Puppis, is one of the hottest and most luminous stars visible to the naked eye, a blue supergiant more than 1,000 light-years away, hundreds of thousands of times more luminous than the Sun. It is racing through space, perhaps after being ejected from its birth cluster.
In 1942, Nova Puppis became one of the brightest novae of the 20th century.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Ahadi](hip:35264) is an orange giant, and [Tureis](hip:39757) a pulsating yellow-white giant. [Taleban](hip:32768) and [Hadir](hip:36377) are orange giants, and [Pipit](hip:31685) is a blue-white giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Puppis is rich in clusters, including M46, M47 and M93, and contains the supernova remnant Puppis A. The red giant L2 Puppis is surrounded by a disk of dust, offering a preview of the Sun’s distant future.
